name: cucumber avocado smoothie
instructions:
Cucumber + green bell pepper + lime + avocado, all in a blender. Kind of a gazpacho — kind of Nisha Vora's avocado gazpacho (Rainbow Plant Life), approached slowly (see notes).

=== INGREDIENTS (SETTLED BUILD) ===

- cucumber
- ANAHEIM PEPPER (or maybe serrano)
- BANANA (important/necessary — a sweet element must exist; maybe pineapple too/instead)
- LIME (incredibly important — see notes; considering 2 limes)
- avocado
- COCONUT MILK or COCONUT WATER (a coconut element helps)
- COCONUT FLAKES
- MINT (tested, good)

=== PROCEDURE ===

Put it all in a blender.
notes:
=== STATUS — PASS ===

Started good-but-bland; the fixes that landed: ANAHEIM over green bell, COCONUT MILK + COCONUT FLAKES, and MINT. Still building gradually rather than committing to Nisha's full build (see reference below).

=== THE PEPPER — ANAHEIM > GREEN BELL ===

Swapped green bell for ANAHEIM and it helped — but anaheim isn't always available. BELL + SERRANO sounds nice as the fallback combination (untested).

=== COCONUT — MILK AND FLAKES BOTH ===

COCONUT MILK (in addition to the rest) helped a lot, and blending in COCONUT FLAKES pushed the flavor even more — a good use for flakes, since they don't get used often.

WANT TO TRY — FLAKES + GREEK YOGURT, NO MILK: just coconut flakes and GREEK YOGURT for tang, rather than the coconut milk itself. (Yogurt graduates from hesitant to a specific plan — the tang slot, paired with the flakes carrying the coconut.)

=== SWEETNESS — CONFIRMED NECESSARY: BANANA ===

Remade and confirmed: BANANA IS IMPORTANT/NECESSARY — a sweet element MUST exist, and a coconut element helps. Pineapple remains the maybe-alternative/addition. Still unsure about MANGO and its effect on the color.

=== HERB — MINT TESTED GOOD; BASIL NEXT; NO CILANTRO ===

MINT was good. Next time: BASIL. CILANTRO seems too obvious — it would push this into mole-verde/savory territory, which isn't the direction.

=== LIME IS INCREDIBLY IMPORTANT ===

The lime is incredibly important — I don't think this would work without it. Next time: maybe 2 LIMES.

=== WANT TO TRY ===

- CILANTRO / MINT — the herb fix for the blandness.
- COCONUT FLAKES blended in (rather than using coconut cream). Coconut makes more sense here than silken tofu for protein — this ISN'T supposed to be a protein shake, and that's fine.
- YOGURT might work, but I'm more hesitant on that one.

=== VANILLA PROTEIN POWDER — CLASHING ===

First verdict was tolerated-not-great; after drinking a whole glass, upgraded to CLASHING — the cucumber/pepper just doesn't like it. ([[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]] is where vanilla protein powder belongs; this one is not a protein shake, full stop.)

=== NISHA REFERENCE — CREAMY AVOCADO PEA GAZPACHO ===

Nisha Vora (Rainbow Plant Life): https://rainbowplantlife.com/creamy-avocado-pea-gazpacho/ — she skips the tomato and does avocado, plus (per usual) a lot of other ingredients: coconut milk, a shallot, peas, olive oil, and SERRANO over bell pepper. Her version requires a lot of commitment, so I'm going slow — this recipe is the gradual approach to that destination.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]] / [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]]: the protein-shake smoothies — this one deliberately isn't one.
- [[blender-cheat-meals]]: variant C's non-savory direction (tomatillos/cucumber/bell pepper) is circling the same gazpacho territory from the savory side.
- [[kachumber]]: the cucumber + lime register in salad form (where cucumber + mango worked and tomato left).
original_chef: Mine — a slow approach toward Nisha Vora's creamy avocado pea gazpacho (Rainbow Plant Life).
